title: observability: token-level KV tracing + enhanced logging, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Asha Raman
release_notes: Add token-level KV tracing and logging hooks; introduce new Grafana dashboards for token-level cost/latency and KV cache behavior; tune alerts to reduce noise and improve incident signal-to-noise.
description:
Motivation: We need better observability into per-token costs and KV cache behavior to diagnose high-latency requests and unexpected token-cost regressions. This PR adds token-level KV tracing, expands structured logging for request lifecycle events, ships new Grafana dashboards that correlate token cost, latency, and KV cache hit/miss, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce false positives while preserving SLO guardrails.

Summary of changes: implemented a lightweight token-level tracer (opt-in via config) that emits span annotations for KV cache lookups, cache hits/misses, and prefix cache reuse; added structured request lifecycle logs with trace IDs and token metadata; extended the metrics exporter to aggregate token_cost_per_request, token_latency_p50/p95, kv_cache_hit_rate_by_model; added two Grafana dashboards: "Token Cost & Latency (by model)" and "KV Cache Behavior"; refined alert rules to focus on sustained regressions (5m/15m windows) and added suppression for known maintenance windows.

Checklist: - [x] Token-level tracer implementation and config flag - [x] Structured logging fields added to request pipeline - [x] Metrics exporter updates and Prometheus metric names - [x] Grafana dashboards (json) and dashboard sync script - [x] Alert rules and paging thresholds adjusted - [x] Unit + integration tests for tracer and metrics - [x] README/docs update with how to enable and interpret dashboards

Backward compatibility and opt-in: Token-level tracing is disabled by default; enabling requires updating the observability config in Redwood deployments. All metric name changes are additive. No runtime breaking changes expected.

Rollout plan: Deploy to Canary first (observability-canary) with tracer disabled, enable structured logs and metric collection; enable token tracing in Canary only for 48h and validate telemetry cardinality and cost; roll to staging for 72h with alert rules in dry-run, then gradual rollout to prod with target 10% hosts per hour.

Testing: Local unit tests added for tracer + metrics. Ran integration test harness against canary environment. Verified dashboards render with synthetic data and alerts fire in test mode.

Related: ENG-4221 (investigation into token-cost regressions), SUP-9876 (customer report of high token cost for autoregressive endpoint).

review_comments: Jordan Lee: Nice work — the tracer looks lightweight. Two asks: 1) ensure we're sampling to control cardinality, 2) make sure the Prometheus labels don't explode. Can you add a sampling config and label cardinality doc?

Author (Asha Raman): Added sampling config (observability.tracing.token_sampling_rate) with 0.01 default and documented label cardinality strategies in token-level-tracing.md. Also limit model_label to sanitized model family names.

Priya Patel: Alert tuning changes look sensible. Suggest increasing the sustained window for token_cost SLO alert from 5m to 15m for global endpoints to reduce noise. Also ensure suppression during rolling kernel updates.
Author (Asha Raman): Increased window to 15m for global endpoints and added suppression rule for infra/maintenance tags. Verified in staging dry-run.
Samir Gupta: Can we add a small benchmark for tracer overhead? Please confirm p95 CPU/latency impact at 1% sampling.
Author (Asha Raman): Ran microbenchmarks in canary: at 1% sampling tracer added ~0.3% p95 latency and ~<1% CPU overhead. Results attached as CI artifact.
merge_result: Merged via squash on 2026-02-24 by Priya Patel. Merge commit message: "observability: token-level KV tracing + logging and dashboards (ENG-4221)"
notes: We will monitor metric cardinality dashboards for 72h post-rollout. If cardinality increases beyond threshold, revert token tracing flag to false for affected hosts and investigate. Ops runbook updated with steps to disable tracer and clean up high-cardinality label values.
